items.quote: Die Nachzahlung von 1.284,00 € ist bis zum 04.05.2027 fällig.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar due date: 04.05.2027. Checking the weekday: 2027-05-04 is a Tuesday, a normal working day, so no weekend/holiday adjustment under § 108 Abs. 3 AO is needed. Due date as printed: 2027-05-04.

items.title: File Einspruch (tax objection) against the Einkommensteuerbescheid 2025
items.quote: Ihr Einspruch muss innerhalb eines Monats eingelegt werden; die Monatsfrist rechnet vom Ende des Tages an, an dem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist.
items.computation: The letter states a separate posting date ('Zur Post gegeben am 25.03.2027'), which governs delivery instead of the Bescheiddatum (23.03.2027). Posting was on/after 1 Jan 2025, so delivery (Bekanntgabe) is deemed on the 4th day after posting (§ 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO, PostModG): 25.03.2027 + 4 days = 29.03.2027 (a Monday). Since this 4th day is not a Saturday, Sunday or holiday, no shift applies for tax offices (§ 108 Abs. 3 AO only shifts if the 4th day itself falls on such a day). So Bekanntgabe = 29.03.2027. Under § 355 Abs. 1 AO together with §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB, the one-month period starts the day after delivery and ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number: 29.03.2027 + 1 month = 29.04.2027 (a Thursday), which is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in Bremen, so no further shift. Final Einspruch deadline: 2027-04-29.
